criteria.evidence: rotateSession moves the presented hash to previousTokenHash; presenting a rotated token revokes every session of that user and logs session.reuse_detected and session.revoked. Covered by server/tests/session-rotation.test.ts, server/tests/session-mutations.test.ts and the Playwright scenario, which confirms revocation with a direct database query.

The BFF moves the issued refresh token into an httpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Lax cookie and returns refreshToken: null. Playwright web/tests/e2e/23-session-cookie.spec.ts asserts document.cookie holds neither the cookie name nor its value and that the jar entry is httpOnly. Executed in CI only — no Docker daemon locally.

logoutAll revokes all sessions of the user including the current one (ADR-0009 п. 4); no active session remains and another user's session is untouched. Covered by server/tests/session-mutations.test.ts and the Playwright scenario with two browser contexts.
